title: Device for controlling the flow of a fluid with in-built pressure threshold detection

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.quote: The device also comprises an electrical connection intended to be connected to a detection system, said detection system forming, with at least the conducting area of the frame and the internal element, an electrical detection circuit
features.note: The reference discloses a detection system that forms an electrical detection circuit to detect a threshold pressure, implying a pressure sensing capability, but it does not explicitly mention a 'pressure sensor' or 'monitoring vacuum level'.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.quote: An indicator light may for example be lit, said indicator light being mounted for example in series in the detection circuit. Any other alarm device may be implemented.
features.note: The reference discloses an indicator light or alarm device activated by the detection system when a pressure threshold is met, but it does not specify that this threshold is 'above release vacuum level' or that it's for a 'vacuum lifting device'.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.quote: The detection system detects that the pressure of the fluid is below the threshold pressure. An indicator light may for example be lit, said indicator light being mounted for example in series in the detection circuit.
features.note: The reference describes an indicator light that is lit when the pressure is below a threshold, and goes out when the pressure is above it, implying it remains active while the condition persists. However, it does not explicitly state it 'remains active' or refer to 'grip vacuum'.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord

overall.why: The reference describes a device for controlling fluid flow and detecting pressure thresholds, which is a different application (valves in hydraulic circuits) than a vacuum lifting device.
